title: Cassava Leaf Stew
description: Cassava Leaf Stew is a Sierra Leone classic prepared with yellow onion, tomato, beef chuck, peanut butter. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. This is a spinach-based adaptation, NOT cassava-leaf stew: fresh cassava leaves are missing and require special detoxification. Never substitute untreated leaves.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 48 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
Cook the spinach fully in the nutty stew for the final 15 minutes. This variation intentionally uses NO cassava leaves.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
